messages:
oncall-bot: Incident 1999991234 — GPU prefill OOMs detected on us-west-2 serving pool. Pager: @sre-aly. Containers restarting.

sre-aly: Got the page, joining bridge. Any initial customer impact?

prodops-rita: Seeing elevated 5xxs for /v1/generate tied to acct-284. ~15% of requests failing with immediate container restarts.

eng-runtime-jin: Logs show repeated 'CUDA error: CUBLAS_STATUS_ALLOC_FAILED' then OOMKilled. Kernel log snippet points to huge prefill allocations from single session (very large context window).

deploy-bot: Container restart excerpt:
```
[2026-03-17T03:12:05Z] model-server[4321]: allocating KV cache -> oom
[pid 1] Killed process 4321 (model-server) total-vm: 92G, anon-rss: 78G
CUDA: 0: out of memory
```

sre-aly: Mitigation plan: 1) apply short-term rate-limit on long-context uploads, 2) divert heavy sessions to cold-model pool, 3) reduce max_context for the hot pool. I'll implement the rate-limit rule now.

eng-ml-sam: We have a q4-quantized variant ready for failover (lower mem). It'll increase latency ~10-20% but avoids OOM. Prep switch config in case.

sre-aly: Rate-limit applied: route /v1/generate now enforces context_size <= 300k tokens for hosted-pool. Observability: restarting frequency dropping but see some flapping from in-flight sessions.

infra-lee: Isolating node node-usw2-037 (cordon + drain). Noisy tenant suspected. Starting drain to stop further restarts.

eng-runtime-jin: Hotpatch pushed: disabled aggressive prefetch of KV cache during prefill for all models on canary (3 pods). This reduces peak GPU memory during initial prefill.

sre-aly: Canary rollout looks good: canary pods up 10m, no restarts. Overall container restarts down ~90%.

cs-omar: Notified customer acct-284: "We're throttling extremely long inputs while we stabilize the cluster; we expect full service in ~2 hours." Customer asked for ETA and mitigation note.

eng-runtime-jin: ETA: 2 hours to full rollback provided no regression. Longer term action: validate request lengths server-side and enforce sane defaults, add token-metering alerts.

sre-aly: Creating handoff notes and leaving bridge. Handoff to night oncall @sre-night. Key items: rate-limit rule, drained node, canary hotpatch, q4 failover ready. :white_check_mark:

sre-night: Acknowledged. Will monitor for 6 hours and escalate if restarts >3 in 15m.

oncall-bot: Incident status changed: mitigated -> monitoring. Postmortem required: root cause suspected unbounded client prefill + aggressive prefetch causing KV cache explosion on GPUs.

sre-aly: Follow-up tasks assigned: permanent request validation, default max_context reduction, add circuit-breaker for prefill size, and customer follow-up doc. Closing bridge. :thumbsup:
